newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Pao de Acucar Jan-Sept net 69.8 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Pao de Acucar Jan-Sept net 69.8 mln reais.

text.p: Brazilian supermarket chain Grupo Pao de Acucar said it had a 69.8 million real net profit in the first nine months of the year, an increase of 58.4 percent compared with the same period of 1995.
In the third quarter, its net profit rose 72.7 percent to 23.8 million reais, with net sales increasing 17.8 percent to 741.3 million reais, the firm said in a statement.
In the January-to-September period, net sales rose 12.2 percent, against the same period last year, it added.
Pao de Acucar also said it invested 73.3 million reais in the first nine months, of which 31 million reais came in the third quarter.
